comment: Figure 3.1 states that “each lower element realises the one above.” This oversimplifies the architecture because not all relationships in the traceability chain are realisation relationships. For example, capabilities may serve goals, outcomes realise goals, and components may realise services.

public.text: Figure 3.1 states that “each lower element realises the one above.” This oversimplifies the architecture because not all relationships in the traceability chain are realisation relationships. For example, capabilities may serve goals, outcomes realise goals, and components may realise services.
public.suggestedRevision: Revise the figure and caption to show the correct relationship type at each step. Avoid presenting all vertical relationships as realisation. Provide a legend identifying serving, realisation, composition, and access relationships.
